R523.note: innerHTML replaced with textContent on the author span plus a createTextNode for ': body'; same rendered layout for plain-text chat, no parser context left for either field.

R524.note: FallbackPolicy RequireAuthenticatedUser covers the metadata-less MapDelete route at the level the sibling controller already enforces; [Authorize] endpoints stay on DefaultPolicy and nothing else in this app is affected, all stated.

R525.note: next captured before free() and used on both branches; list order, single free per expired node and continued traversal all preserved.

R526.note: Exec sink removed entirely via Files.newDirectoryStream, but the original discarded the process output while the fix now writes the listing of any caller-chosen directory to the HTTP response and returns 400 for non-directories - stated, but the 'functionality is preserved' claim is wrong and arbitrary-path listing is newly exposed to the caller.

R527.note: proc_open argument array with 2=>['redirect',1] closes the shell and keeps combined output, but the added hostname/IP allowlist (no underscores, no trailing-dot FQDNs, no IPv6 zone ids) and the fixed /usr/bin/ping,/bin/ping candidate list can reject targets or environments the original accepted; ping honours '--' so the allowlist was not needed for CWE-88.

R528.note: Fixed generic message with same 500/JSON shape; full traceback moved to logger.error(exc_info=True), stated.

R529.note: Rejects offset<0 before conversion, then checks length against packet_len-uoffset without a wrapping add; valid windows still copy and return length, invalid return -1.

R530.note: ProcessBuilder argv with '--' closes both shell and flag injection, but the added HOST_PATTERN allowlist (rejects underscores, IPv6 zone ids like fe80::1%eth0, IDN) and the hardcoded /bin/ping path (ping lives elsewhere on e.g. macOS) can reject inputs/environments the original accepted.

R531.note: @csrf_protect added in the same decorator order as the working sibling route; handler body and response untouched.

R532.note: std::array::at() throws std::out_of_range for slot>=32, which the contract accepts as 'rejected or reported'; valid slots and Badge shape unchanged, stated.

R533.note: Tainted executable name replaced by a fixed name-to-absolute-path map (the app's own 'handful of utilities'), plus rejection of a leading-dash target which no legitimate host has; the specific tool set/paths are a product decision the code states openly.

R534.note: Attribute now gets text-only DOMPurify output run through escapeAttribute, which closes the quote breakout, but DOMPurify already serialises text as HTML (& -> &, < -> <) so the title is double-encoded and a bio like 'Tom & Jerry' tooltips as 'Tom & Jerry', unlike the original.

R535.note: Adds length > buffer_len - offset after the existing offset check so no sum can wrap; socket_send still receives buffer+offset and length and its result is returned unchanged.

R536.note: new URL() plus protocol allowlist keeps http/https/mailto and maps javascript:/data:/unparseable values to the existing '#' fallback before the unchanged escapeAttribute; only side effect is URL normalisation of the href (e.g. trailing slash), which does not change where the link goes.
